map.减脂/增肌/维持期，根据体重与体脂先算 BMR，再按活动系数得 TDEE，最后把: For cutting, bulking or maintenance: compute BMR from weight and body fat first, apply the activity factor to get TDEE, then split the target calories into grams of the three macronutrients.
map.提供体脂时用 Katch-McArdle 公式（基于瘦体重）估算 BMR，比单纯: When body fat is provided, BMR is estimated with the Katch-McArdle formula (based on lean body mass), which is more accurate than using weight alone.

map.未提供体脂时工具退化为 22×体重 的简化估算（本例约 1540 kcal），会: Without body fat the tool falls back to the simplified 22 × body weight estimate (about 1540 kcal in this example), which runs slightly below Katch-McArdle. Measuring body fat once with calipers or InBody is recommended so BMR tracks actual resting expenditure more closely.
map.减脂期碳水是不是越低越好？: Is lower carbohydrate always better when cutting?
map.不是。碳水过低会影响训练表现与甲状腺素，本例减脂期蛋白系数提到 2.2g/kg: No. Too little carbohydrate hurts training performance and thyroxine; in this fat-loss example the protein factor is raised to 2.2 g/kg to preserve muscle, fat is 0.8 g/kg to support hormones, and carbohydrate still supplies most of the calories. A fat-loss deficit of 300-500 kcal/day is generally enough.
